description: This file defines the RolesPermissionsService class, which manages role permissions including retrieval, addition, removal, and setting permissions, with dependency on role service, cache, and output services.

classes.name: RolesPermissionsService
classes.description: Service class for managing role permissions, including CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: getRolePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specific role within a team.

methods.name: addRolePermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions to a role, updating the role and clearing cache.

methods.name: removeRolePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific permission from a role after validation.

methods.name: removeRolePermissions
methods.description: Removes multiple permissions from a role after validation.

methods.name: setRolePermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions for a role, replacing existing permissions.
